dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Linta and Molo Straits
dct_description_sm: From the latest Netherlands Government surveys ; Published Sep., 1919, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Conversion Table, Malayan and English Terms.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water, reefs, peaks.
